posts.name: GreenXLantern
posts.cooked: After GenCon, I'm testing out the RPG with my two daughters (who love the card game).  My one daughter is a diehard fan of Young Legacy.  I got the starter kit at GenCon - any suggestions on how to modify the Legacy character to make it Young Legacy.  I would think it would be as easy as replacing some of the qualities and Galvanize with Atomic Glare, but I'm not sure how Atomic Glare would look in the abilities.  Any suggestions would make a 10 year old fan very happy!!!

posts.name: speedyolrac
posts.cooked:
You might wanna wait till the generator is out.

If not I would Take Legacy and change some of it's power/Quilties to fit, Make Atomic glare a green power that attacks {Power}. hinder that target with your min., replacing Heroic charge. (Or Galvanise, depending on how she wants to play, also with 2 players galvanize is not that great).

Alternative you can say Atomic glare Ignores all penalties on the roll (they do not get used up), any defend and not be reacted.

I would replace Awareness with Glare (and then maybe swap some dice around)

What are you replacing History and Imposing with?
